comparison.objective: Open breaker clamps, insert a three-pin comb busbar, and tighten every terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated screwdriver use, simultaneous multi-pin alignment, insertion, and clamping.
comparison.success_condition: All pins home, all screws tightened, comb withstands a 10 N pull, screwdriver and fingertips clear, and state held two seconds.
comparison.reason: Tests tool-prepared multi-point electrical insertion and fastening, not material classification through a screen.
